quarantined.reason: PDF Table 2 p.8 distinguishes PSAF and LSAF effects: LSAF FA correlates with fluency but not repetition; PSAF FA correlates with repetition but not fluency. The pooled any-subsets except fluency and/or repetition wording needs tract-specific clarification.

Draft describes Spearman analyses and an unqualified ASAF null, but PDF Table 2 p.8 reports ASAF fiber-number/fluency p=.032. Table 3 adjusted associations are nonsignificant; specify analysis and metric rather than a blanket null.
PDF pp.1,9-11: A-versus-C contrast concerns 8 completely and 12 partially reconstructed participants; the draft assigns the whole 26-person cohort to this pairwise finding.
PDF pp.1,9,11: A-versus-B contrast uses 8 completely reconstructed and 6 non-reconstructed participants, not all 26 participants as the draft sample indicates.
PDF pp.1,11-12: B-versus-C contrast concerns 6 non-reconstructed and 12 partially reconstructed participants, not the whole 26-person cohort stated in the draft.
PDF pp.6,9: interhemispheric aSTG connection result is an FA association, not the LSM method assigned to this draft.
PDF pp.6,11: groups are defined by reconstruction of the whole left AF, not the left PSAF as stated in the draft exposure description. Correct group definition before publication.
PDF pp.4-5: association uses mean FA in TBSS-defined SLF clusters; LSM method label does not describe this diffusion analysis.

PDF Table 3 p.8: adjusted LSAF comprehension, naming and AQ associations are significant for FA but not fiber number; AQ FA r=.504 also exceeds the paper strong-correlation threshold. Draft groups FA and fiber number and labels all associations moderate.

PDF Table 3 p.8: adjusted PSAF naming association is FA-specific (r=.488), while fiber number is nonsignificant (p=.220). Draft groups FA and fiber number and calls all listed associations strong; distinguish metrics and strengths before review.
PDF pp.6,9: FA correlations in template-defined tracts are diffusion/tractography analyses, not the LSM method assigned to this draft.
